text: WIDEN: we recommend turning routing on for the whole team. Across the 10 opt-in engineers, routing served $139.69 against a $221 baseline, saving $81.31 (36.8%). That covers 2,565 priced rows, none skipped, including 588 subscription rows, over 1,552 main-loop turns. Every gate rule held on the 1 run evaluated with no critical failures, and no engineer failed a check against our thresholds: router failure 0.5%, failover 2.0%, bad tool args 0.5%, p90 latency ratio 1.2. This is the corrected savings figure and replaces the earlier docs SQL estimate. Next, we'll enable routing team-wide and keep the same checks running so any regression surfaces quickly.
